[b]A new dawn for Baliz[/b]

The THEP occupation of the Balizid territories has officially come to an end, with the occupational government formally dissolving itself, after announcing the specifics of the next regime. The news would be broadcast throughout the country and across the world, detailing the following information.

The new name for the Balizid territories is [b]The Shamatine Kingdom of Baliz[/b].

As the name suggests, the country will fall under a constitutional monarchy, as per a series of votes within THEP, which indicated that this would be the right path for the future of the country and the Balizid people.

The new king of Baliz has been decided through tracking the genetic bloodline of the Balizid caliphs of the 9th century, whom which the territory derives it name from. Ibrahim al-Badzir was found to be the most  direct descendant of the Balizid dynasty, despite now living as a wealthy businessman in [nation]Baladullah[/nation]. Ibrahim has now travelled to Baliz and been crowned as King Ibrahim I bin Abdullah bin Faisal Al-Baliz. Ibrahims power will be limited to ensure the will of the people and the preservation of democracy. The prime minister and his cabinet will hold most of the countrys power. Democratic elections are due to take place next week. Until then, THEP has placed their own prime minister, Amir bin-saman in power, who has formed a temporary cabinet. Amir was a prominent leader in the anti-jihad espionage movement from within the Sal-Baliz which helped greatly throughout the invasion.

The new states territory has been reorganised into 8 provinces and 2 condominiums, moving the country towards a more federal model. Additionally, a section of land has been seceded from the north of the country to form a corridor in the south, allowing Baliz to border [nation]Nordiheim[/nation] to facilitate trade. Each Province will be headed by a ceremonial prince, with limited power and a democratically elected Governor. Ibrahims 3 sons have been given multiple provinces each, until they each have children and can pass on power.

The condominiums will be dealt with differently. Special shared condominiums have been arranged with the monarchies of Elseyr-Vespurias and the Bobian Empire. In each of these condominiums, A Balizid prince will serve a ceremonial role, the same as a regular province, however the governor will be appointed by the government of Elseyr-Vespurias or Bob. Additionally, a chief minister will be appointed by the Balizid government, allowing the administration to be shared between both states. The Principality of Sheba (Elseyr-Vespurian condominium) will additionally be split in half, one for Elseyr-Thýven and one for Vespurias, due to the current union that governs them.

Map of the new state: https://i.postimg.cc/pXcf5d03/balizy-2.png
